# Copilot instructions

This repository is the `gh-dxp` GitHub CLI extension, written in Go.

## Code review output

- Report findings and material review limitations, not approval decisions.
- Never recommend approval or merging. Do not use "Approval recommended",
  "Approved", "LGTM", "safe to merge", or equivalent verdicts.
- If no issues are found, say: "No findings."

## Stack

- Go 1.27.1
- GitHub CLI extension built with Cobra and Bubble Tea
